CLI 已安装。现在可以登录或读取录音。: CLI installed. You can now sign in or read recordings.
KITE CLI 需要支持 twin 命令。: KITE CLI must support the twin command.
KITE Twin 尚未取得截屏权限。请在「录屏与系统录音」中打开 KITE T: KITE Twin does not have screen recording permission. Turn on KITE Twin in “Screen & System Audio Recording.” If it is already on, quit and reopen Twin.
KITE 会从这个项目读取技能。: KITE reads skills from this project.
KITE 正在处理上一条消息。: KITE is processing the previous message.
KITE 没有返回可交接的任务。: KITE did not return any tasks to hand off.
KITE 读取你选中的原消息，生成一份可编辑的草稿。: KITE reads the original message you selected and generates an editable draft.
Memoket 暂时无法读取录音。请检查网络和账号权限后重试。: Memoket can’t read recordings right now. Check your network and account permissions, then try again.
Memoket 未标记本人说话人: Memoket did not identify your speaker.
Memoket 返回了无法读取的结果。请检查 CLI 版本后重试。: Memoket returned unreadable results. Check the CLI version, then try again.
从你本人的记忆中自动提炼，用于起草回复和执行任务。: Automatically distilled from your own memories for drafting replies and completing tasks.
先核对引用和任务，然后交给 %@ 执行。: Review the sources and task, then open it in %@.
任务已复制。在 Claude Code 的项目中粘贴并运行。: Task copied. Paste and run it in a Claude Code project.
任务已复制。在 Codex 粘贴并发送。: Task copied. Paste and send it in Codex.
例如：按最新决定更新发布计划，并运行检查。: For example: Update the release plan based on the latest decisions, then run the checks.
先在飞书打开一条消息的回复框。: First, open the reply field for a message in Feishu.
先选中要回复的消息。: First, select the message you want to reply to.
先选择任务要在哪个项目里执行。: First, choose the project where the task should run.
先预览内容，再决定是否保存到当前工作区。: Preview the content first, then decide whether to save it to the current workspace.
再添加一份资料，就能孵化小人。: Add one more resource to hatch the avatar.
再点小人收起转盘: Tap the avatar again to collapse the wheel.
单份文档最多 10,000 个非空原文行。: Each document can contain up to 10,000 non-empty source-text lines.
原应用没有回到前台。请切回去再试。: The source app did not return to the foreground. Switch back to it and try again.
原应用没有接受写入。草稿仍在 KITE 中。: The source app did not accept the write. The draft is still in KITE.
原文和索引已保存，可以在记忆图查看。: The source text and index have been saved. View them in the Memory Graph.
原文和英文视图已保存，可以在记忆图切换。: The source text and English view have been saved. Switch between them in the Memory Graph.
回复下列收到的消息。用已确认的证据，不要声称一项工作已完成，除非证据显示已完成。: Reply to the received message below. Use confirmed evidence; do not claim work is complete unless the evidence shows it is complete.
在 Codex 查看并发送任务。: View and send tasks in Codex.
在 macOS 的「辅助功能」里允许 KITE Twin，然后回到原应用选中消息: Allow KITE Twin in macOS Accessibility, then return to the original app and select a message.
在回复编辑区显示小人提示: Show the avatar suggestion in the reply editor
在记忆库里查看资料，或继续用原文推进任务。: View materials in Memory, or continue the task using the original text.
在转盘或记忆页导入文件: Import files from the wheel or Memory page
在转盘或记忆页开始或停止录音: Start or stop recording from the wheel or Memory page
在转盘或记忆页截屏: Take a screenshot from the wheel or Memory page
填入原应用回复框: Fill in the reply field in the original app
填入转写中代表你的名字，KITE 就能从你的发言里提炼画像。: Enter the name that represents you in transcripts so KITE can build a profile from what you say.
填写一个关注主题，例如「APP 外测」。新资料里有相关内容时，小人会提醒你。: Enter a topic to follow, such as “APP beta testing.” The avatar will notify you when new material is relevant.
安装 Memoket CLI 失败。请检查网络后重试，或按官方说明安装。: Couldn’t install Memoket CLI. Check your network connection and try again, or install it following the official instructions.
安装后，用你的 Memoket 账号连接。: After installation, connect with your Memoket account.
完成一项任务后，在任务页带回结果，再选「保存为项目技能」。: After completing a task, return the results on the Tasks page, then choose “Save as Project Skill.”
完成并确认一项任务，小人会获得星光。: Complete and confirm a task to earn starlight for the avatar.
对话里出现了新的后续线索: New follow-up leads appeared in the conversation
导入一份资料，小人的蛋壳会裂开。: Import a reference file to crack your character’s shell.
尚未获得辅助功能授权: Accessibility permission has not been granted.
已保存到项目技能目录。: Saved to the project skills directory.
已填入原回复框。请在网页里核对。: Filled into the original reply field. Please review it on the webpage.
已记住此渠道的回复偏好。: Remembered reply preferences for this channel.
引用已变化或回复框已有内容，请回到飞书核对，再重新起草。: The quoted content has changed or the reply field already contains text. Return to Feishu to review, then draft again.
当前运行的 KITE Twin 尚未取得截屏权限。: The running KITE Twin does not have Screen Recording permission.
当前运行的 KITE Twin 已获准截屏。: The running KITE Twin has been granted Screen Recording permission.
录制麦克风与系统音频，结束后可在本机转写。: Record microphone and system audio; transcribe locally after finishing.
录音正在进行，停止后可播放或转写。: Recording in progress. You can play or transcribe it after stopping.
找不到这条录音的转写。: Transcript not found for this recording.
把一次任务中核对过的做法保存到项目，下次可以直接复用。: Save verified approaches from a task to the project for direct reuse next time.
把这块拖到飞书当前引用下面的输入区。: Drag this into the input area below the current quote in Feishu.
拖入飞书原回复框: Drag into Feishu's original reply box
拖出截图范围，预览图片和识别出的文字。: Drag to select a screenshot area and preview the image and recognized text.
拖动选择区域，松开后预览: Drag to select an area, then release to preview
拖动选择截屏区域，按 Escape 取消: Drag to select a screenshot area. Press Escape to cancel.
新增或更新的记忆提到这个主题时，小人会提醒你。: When newly added or updated memories mention this topic, your companion will remind you.
暂无待跟进的原文。你也可以直接说明要做什么。: There are no source messages to follow up on. You can also say directly what you'd like to do.
暂时没有可显示的录音。: There are no recordings to display yet.
暂时没有足够的自述来生成画像。: There isn't enough self-description yet to generate a profile.
有进展后要做的事（可选）: What to do when there is progress (optional)
未完成 Memoket 登录。请检查浏览器后重试。: Memoket sign-in was not completed. Check your browser and try again.
未收到网页回填确认。请检查原回复框，草稿仍保留在 KITE。: No confirmation was received that the webpage was filled in. Check the original reply field; the draft is still saved in KITE.
查看或修改从记忆自动生成的画像。: View or edit the profile automatically generated from memories.
核对名称、使用场景和做法，再保存到当前项目。: Review the name, use case, and approach, then save to the current project.
核对最新原文和项目现状，找出可以推进的下一步。: Review the latest source text and current project status to identify the next actionable step.
核对草稿后，在原应用发送。: Review the draft, then send it in the original app.
核对这条线索和后续原文。若有明确可执行的更新，请完成并带回检查结果。: Review this lead and the subsequent source text. If there is a clear actionable update, complete it and return the results for review.
根据记忆推进任务: Move the task forward based on memory
桌面端可用「服务」菜单的「用 KITE 起草回复」，网页使用 KITE 浏览器扩: On desktop, use “Draft Reply with KITE” from the “Services” menu; on the web, use the KITE browser extension.
正在核对原网页的回复框…: Checking the reply field on the original webpage…
正在核对飞书的回复引用…: Checking the reply reference in Feishu…
没找到该主题的原文；已根据收到的消息起草。: Couldn’t find the source text for this topic; drafted based on the message received.
没有可用于采集系统音频的屏幕。: No display is available for capturing system audio.
没有找到 npm。请先安装 Node.js 18 或更新版本。: npm wasn’t found. Install Node.js 18 or later first.
没有找到匹配的待跟进原文。: No matching source text to follow up on was found.
没有收到下一页转写。请重试。: Didn’t receive the next transcript page. Try again.
没有绑定到原消息的回复框。请先在原应用打开这条消息的回复，再从原消息起草。: No reply field is linked to the original message. Open a reply to this message in the original app, then draft from the original message.
没有识别到文字。请写一句说明，让 KITE 能通过文字找到这份记忆。: No text was recognized. Add a brief description so KITE can find this memory by text.
没有采集到声音。请检查录音权限和输入设备。: No audio was captured. Check recording permission and the input device.
没读到回复引用。请先在飞书对原消息点「回复」。: Couldn’t read the reply reference. In Feishu, reply to the original message first.
浏览器回复桥已断开，草稿保留在 KITE。: The browser reply bridge disconnected. The draft is saved in KITE.
现在的回复引用和原消息不一致。请回原消息重新起草。: The current reply reference doesn’t match the original message. Return to the original message and draft again.
由此设置记忆图的默认语言。: Set the default language for the memory graph here.
网页回复已断开。请在原网页重新起草。: Web reply disconnected. Draft again on the original webpage.
网页用户：固定 KITE 浏览器扩展。打开原消息的回复、选择正文，然后按 ⌃⇧R: Web users: Pin the KITE browser extension. Open a reply to the original message, select the message body, then press ⌃⇧R or click the extension icon.
草稿已填入，请在原应用确认后发送。: Draft inserted. Confirm it in the original app, then send.
要做什么？: What would you like to do?
让画像改变小人外观: Let Profile change the avatar’s appearance
设为此应用的默认回复偏好: Set as the default reply preference for this app
请先登录 Memoket，再读取录音。: Please sign in to Memoket before reading recordings.
请在原应用点一下同一个回复框，把光标放在末尾，再回到 KITE 点击填入。: In the original app, click the same reply field, place the cursor at the end, then return to KITE and click Fill In.
请在浏览器完成 Memoket 登录。: Complete Memoket sign-in in your browser.
请选择 PDF、DOCX、RTF、ODT 或文本文件。: Please select a PDF, DOCX, RTF, ODT, or text file.
请选择本地 kite-tool 和工作区目录。: Please select the local kite-tool and workspace folder.
转写分页不完整。请重新打开这条录音。: The transcript is paginated incompletely. Reopen this recording.
转写后才能保存为可搜索的记忆。首次转写需要选择本机语音模型。: You can save it as searchable memory only after transcription. For your first transcription, select a local speech model.
这个回复框已有草稿。KITE 保留了里面的内容。: This reply field already has a draft. KITE has preserved its contents.
这个项目还没有技能: This project has no skills yet.
这份原件已经建过索引。: This original file has already been indexed.
这条备注是我的自述，可更新画像: This note is my self-description and can update my profile.
这条录音还没有可导入的转写。: This recording does not have a transcript available to import yet.
这次怎么回复，例如：简短，明确下一步: How should this reply be written? For example: brief, with clear next steps
连接 Memoket CLI，选择一份已转写的录音。: Connect to Memoket CLI and select a transcribed recording.
连接后会显示小人的成长进度。: After connecting, the character's growth progress will be displayed.
适用于 Slack、飞书桌面端和 Gmail 网页。停在编辑区几秒后提示。: Works with Slack, Feishu desktop, and Gmail on the web. A prompt appears after you pause in the editing area for a few seconds.
选一个本机 Whisper 模型，用于将录音转成可搜索的文字。: Choose a local Whisper model to convert recordings into searchable text.
选一条录音，核对转写原文，再保存到当前记忆库。: Select a recording, review the transcript, then save it to the current memory library.
选中原消息后全局起草: Select the original message, then draft globally
选中原消息，再从「服务」菜单起草。: Select the original message, then draft from the Services menu.
选中的屏幕已断开，请重新截屏。: The selected display has been disconnected. Capture the screen again.
选中要回复的原消息，再按 ⌃⌥R。: Select the original message to reply to, then press ⌃⌥R.
选择工作区、配置提醒，或查看快捷键。: Select a workspace, configure reminders, or view keyboard shortcuts.
选文档或录音文件。也可以把文件拖到面板。: Select a document or audio recording. You can also drag files onto the panel.
面板内切换总览、记忆、任务、回复: Switch between Overview, Memory, Tasks, and Replies in the panel
飞书和 Slack 桌面端选中原消息，按 ⌃⌥R。Gmail、Slack 和飞书: In the Feishu and Slack desktop apps, select the original message and press ⌃⌥R. For Gmail, Slack, and Feishu on the web, use the KITE browser extension shortcut ⌃⇧R.
